FIELD BRIEF — Command Nexus Status API (fictional)

Objective:
Read the facility status board so CONTROL can confirm which security layers are still armed.

Resources:
- Status documents live at /api/nexus/status.
- This terminal binds to the primary status board only.

Method semantics:
- GET retrieves the current status snapshot.
- Write methods (POST/PUT/DELETE) change facility state and are wrong for a read.

Rules:
- No path parameters, query string, or body.
- Construct method and path yourself from these rules.

Objective:
Inspect the core-loop power circuit so the breach team can isolate it safely.

Resources:

- Substitute {circuitId} with this panel's circuit code: core-loop.

Method semantics:

- POST/PUT/DELETE alter circuits and are wrong for inspection.

Rules:

- Construct method and path with the substituted circuit id yourself.

FIELD BRIEF — Nexus Alarm Filter API (fictional)

Objective:
List active alarms for the core security zone.

Resources:
- Collection: /api/nexus/alarms
- Required query parameter name: zone
- This console is wired to zone core.
- Illustrative shape only: /api/nexus/alarms?zone=<zoneCode>

Method semantics:
- GET filters the alarm collection.
- Write methods do not list alarms.

Rules:
- Construct method and full path-plus-query yourself from this brief.

FIELD BRIEF — Nexus Breach Report API (fictional)

Objective:
File the core breach seal report so automated bulkheads close behind the team.

Resources:
- Report submission endpoint: /api/nexus/breach-reports/core
- This desk only accepts the core report id embedded in the path.

Method semantics:
- POST creates/submits the breach report.
- GET only reads prior reports. PUT/DELETE are wrong for first-time filing.

Rules:
- No query string. Body may be empty for this fictional contract.
- Construct method and path yourself.

FIELD BRIEF — Nexus Lockdown Control API (fictional)

Objective:
Update the alpha-wing lockdown mode so patrols divert away from the vault corridor.

Resources:
- Lockdown records live under /api/nexus/lockdowns/{sectorId}.
- Substitute {sectorId} with this console's sector code: alpha-wing.

Method semantics:
- PUT replaces/updates the existing lockdown record.
- GET only reads. POST creates new sectors. DELETE removes records and is wrong here.

Rules:
- No query string. Body may be empty for this fictional contract.
- Construct method and path with the substituted sector id yourself.
